_about: Variant of the SEALED-MODULE case in which synth_app declares the sealed module in its 'deps'. This is the exact hole that hid eight clash-qt targets: 'deps' is consulted before exceptions, so the edge becomes permanently allowed -- no owner, no removal phase, invisible to the ratchet -- and, because the allowlist short-circuits before match_edge() runs, the site that WAS tracking it now reads as discharged debt. Expected: ARCH-R4-SEALED-MODULE-DECLARED-DEP and, as a consequence, ARCH-R4-STALE-EXCEPTION.

synth_app._note: The defect: the link is declared as an ordinary dep instead of being baselined.

synth_tool._note: Declared so that its link to the sealed module is visible at all: an undeclared executable is invisible to the consumer allowlist.

sealed_modules.reason: While SEAL-baseline is open, synth_impl may be reached only through a baselined site: never through a 'deps' declaration, which check_targets() honours before it consults exceptions, and never by a target the ledger does not name.

exceptions.reason: Stands in for G2-consumers-link-component-private: the targets that still link the component-private module, each with an owner and a removal phase.
